WITH StateCounts AS (
    SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount
    FROM Invoice
    GROUP BY BillingState
), GroupStats AS (
    SELECT InvoiceCount,
           CAST(InvoiceCount AS REAL) / SUM(InvoiceCount) OVER () AS Share,
           AVG(CAST(InvoiceCount AS REAL)) OVER () AS AverageCount
    FROM StateCounts
)
SELECT SUM(InvoiceCount) AS TotalInvoices,
       AVG(Share) AS AverageShare,
       AVG(InvoiceCount - AverageCount) AS AverageExcessCount
FROM GroupStats
WHERE InvoiceCount > AverageCount;
